title: Move 37 and the chain of thought

questions.prompt: Which part of AlphaGo found Move 37?
feedback: The intuition is half of it. It rated the move one chance in ten thousand.
The search is half of it. It played a move the intuition nearly dismissed.
Both. The policy network gave it one chance in ten thousand. The search played it anyway.

questions.prompt: Is a chain of thought a search?
feedback: It can look like one: it writes 'wait' and changes course, and it can be sampled many times.
Not quite nothing. It can turn mid-sentence, and it can be voted on.
Partly. It can write 'wait' and turn, and be sampled and voted on. Nothing checks each step.

questions.prompt: When Claude 3.7 Sonnet used a hint it was given, how often did its reasoning say so?
feedback: Far less often than that. Chen et al., 2025, measured about a quarter.
Lower. The writing named the hint about a quarter of the time.
About 25%. The rest of the time the writing never named the hint. Chen et al., 2025.

questions.prompt: What would make a chain of thought trustworthy?
feedback: Length is not the check. Longer chains of thought are not the same as reasoning.
A record you can check, and then checking it. Pencil, paper, and the method.
Size is not the check. The record is, and the habit of checking it.
